headline: Copper Rebounds Above $5.50 on Tech Sector and AI-Driven Risk-On Mood
summary: Copper futures jumped above $5.50 per pound, recovering from eleven-month lows as global technology stocks advanced and sentiment improved in the artificial intelligence sector, which drives data center construction demand.
why: Copper is heavily utilized in electrical wiring and data center infrastructure; tech sector sentiment directly influences industrial metal demand expectations.

impacts.name: Copper
impacts.why: Improved demand sentiment for data center infrastructure boosts industrial metal futures.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A broader rally in technology and AI-related stocks improved risk sentiment, lifting copper prices from multi-month lows.
